finding: JSON Schema cannot compare two fields, so measure-output-rows.json accepted a row with start_line 40 and end_line 12. BR-130 called only a row that breaks the schema a wrong shape, while the QA strategy counted this case as one. Such a row has an empty range, and no changed line ever judges it. Fix: BR-130 names a row whose start_line is above its end_line as a wrong shape that exits 2 (DEC-42). Raised by the test-strategy agent. Owner: domain-modeling-agent.
why_this_severity: An implementer can still build a gate that ends with a named verdict (no to fails_purpose); the test writer must guess the outcome of an inverted range (raises_cost). No story or code outside the run encodes the statements.
